Markets.title: US stocks today: Nasdaq ends over 1% lower as AI worries persist
Markets.summary: US stocks finished mixed on Monday, with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq closing lower due to declines in Apple and Oracle. The market was weighed down by persistent concerns over Big Tech's AI spending, though falling oil prices provided some relief.

Markets.title: El Nino could add to US inflation pressures in 2027, San Francisco Fed paper warns
Markets.summary: A San Francisco Fed study warns that the current strong El Niño could increase U.S. inflation by 1 percentage point in 2027. This climate shock may create additional pressure on the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates while inflation remains above its 2% target.

Markets.title: US manufacturing strengthens in October, input prices stay high
Markets.summary: US manufacturing activity grew faster than expected in October, driven by strong consumer and AI-related spending. However, high factory input prices continued to raise concerns that inflation will stay above the Federal Reserve's target.

Markets.title: Meta eyes at least $20 billion from potential bond offerings, Bloomberg News reports
Markets.summary: Meta plans to raise at least $20 billion through a cross-border bond offering. The funds will be used to finance the company's expanding artificial intelligence infrastructure.

Markets.title: Anthropic revenue jumps 1,100% ahead of IPO as AI spending commitments near $900 billion
Markets.summary: Ahead of its upcoming IPO, Anthropic reported an 1,100% surge in third-quarter revenue to $17 billion. However, the company also disclosed a $23.3 billion net loss and nearly $895 billion in spending commitments.

Markets.title: Market Trading Guide: Tata Steel among 5 stocks to buy on Tuesday for healthy returns
Markets.summary: Strong Q2 earnings and positive domestic economic indicators helped Indian equities start the week with a strong rally. Consequently, analysts recommended five stocks, including Tata Steel, as potential buys for healthy returns on Tuesday.

Geo-Political.title: Russian bombing kills 26 people at Ukraine aid centre, Kyiv says
Geo-Political.summary: Russian airstrikes involving heavy bombs killed 26 people at an aid center in a southern Ukrainian village. Ukrainian officials condemned the attack, with the president describing it as utterly horrific.

Geo-Political.title: Copilot in deadly Florida jet crash identified in reports as 20-year-old
Geo-Political.summary: Reports have identified the co-pilot of a fatal Florida jet crash as a 20-year-old. Air traffic audio captured a crew member shouting that the aircraft was going to crash into the ground.

Geo-Political.title: Shop freezers in seven European countries hit by cyber-attack
Geo-Political.summary: A cyber-attack targeted shop freezers across seven European countries, causing their temperatures to rise as high as 50 degrees Celsius. The incident disrupted refrigeration systems in multiple retail locations throughout the region.

Geo-Political.title: Fighting returns to Kherson region after longest Ukraine war ceasefire
Geo-Political.summary: Fighting has resumed in the Kherson region of Ukraine following a six-day ceasefire. This unprecedented truce ultimately failed to change the overall trajectory of the ongoing war.

Geo-Political.title: Legal challenge to Australia's social media ban to start in High Court
Geo-Political.summary: A human rights group is launching a High Court challenge against Australia's social media ban for children under 16. The lawsuit argues that the world-first policy unlawfully strips minors of their right to free communication.

Geo-Political.title: Man guilty of stealing cash from farm owned by South African president
Geo-Political.summary: A man was convicted of stealing cash from a farm owned by South African President Cyril Ramaphosa. The theft is part of the "Farmgate" scandal that has resulted in an impeachment saga for the president.

AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment highlights a shift in organic traffic generation from traditional SEO to AI optimization (AIO).

Data & Insights.title: Imports, low base power fastest GST growth in four years in October
Data & Insights.summary: October GST collections exceeded ₹2 trillion for the fourth time this fiscal year. The 23% year-on-year growth was driven by increased import taxes and a low base effect from the previous year.

Data & Insights.title: States get addition instalment of tax devolution of  ₹1.09 lakh crore, supported by strong economy, taxes—See break-up
Data & Insights.summary: The central government has released an additional tax devolution installment of ₹1.09 lakh crore to states. Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman attributed this release to buoyant tax collections and stronger economic activity.

Data & Insights.summary: The upcoming week features key economic reports, including auto sales and PMI numbers. Additionally, markets will closely watch the US mid-term elections.

India.title: Smugglers Attack 3 BSF Jawans In Tripura, Chief Minister Vows Strict Action
India.summary: Smugglers in Tripura attacked three Border Security Force jawans during a pursuit. BSF personnel detained one suspect named Hefzur Rahman approximately 400 meters away from the incident site.

India.title: Massive Fire At Andhra Pradesh Oil Refinery After Explosion, No Casualties
India.summary: A massive fire broke out at an oil refinery in Andhra Pradesh following an explosion, sending thick smoke over nearby neighborhoods. Fortunately, no casualties have been reported from the incident.

India.title: Indian Navy Rescues All 20 Crew Of Pirated Fishing Vessel In Arabian Sea
India.summary: The Indian Navy rescued all 20 crew members of a pirated fishing vessel in the Arabian Sea. Defense Minister Rajnath Singh stated that the operation demonstrated India's commitment to maritime security and regional stability.

India.title: Cyclone Murasu Landfall Begins, Heavy Rain Batters Andhra Coast
India.summary: Cyclone Murasu began making landfall on the Andhra coast at around 1 am on Tuesday. The storm brought heavy rainfall and gale winds with speeds reaching up to 120 kmph.

India.title: NCP Meet Today Amid BJP 'Concern': What Party Leader Said On "Rift" Buzz
India.summary: National Congress Party (NCP) state chief Sunil Tatkare stated that the party is united and has no internal discontent. He clarified that a recent meeting in Delhi was pre-planned, despite rumors of a rift and BJP concerns.

India.title: Arunachal Chief Minister Assures Open Dialogue To Siang Dam Protesters
India.summary: Arunachal Pradesh's chief minister wrote an open letter assuring Siang dam protesters of an open dialogue. He clarified that the government is not currently discussing dam construction.

General.title: Mahmood scraps settlement plans for migrant care workers
General.summary: The home secretary has scrapped proposed changes regarding when migrant care workers can claim permanent residency. She instead outlined a revised plan concerning the settlement timeline for these workers.

General.title: Shop freezers in seven European countries hit by cyber-attack
General.summary: A cyber-attack targeted shop freezers across seven European countries, causing temperatures to rise as high as 50 degrees Celsius. The incident affected the operations of multiple stores in the region.

General.title: 'All this food is now useless': Piles of rubbish after shop freezers hit by cyber-attack
General.summary: A cyber-attack targeted refrigerators and freezers at dozens of supermarkets across seven European countries. Consequently, the stores were forced to dump massive quantities of spoiled food.

General.summary: A private jet crashed in Florida on Sunday, resulting in the deaths of all nine people on board. US authorities are examining the flight data and audio to determine what happened during the aircraft's final moments.
